name: upnext
description: Up next: a side pane that gathers the next steps Claude suggests into a tree you can click to draft, send, hand to background agents or dismiss.

clickAction.title: What a click on a step does
clickAction.description: draft: put the step's prompt in the prompt box for you to edit and send. send: send it right away (⎘ then drafts). Steps from Bash output are always drafted.

extractor.title: How to find next steps
extractor.description: auto: read each reply's headings, lists and offers; when a reply has none, ask a fork of the session (about one short reply) to find implicit steps or guess what you'll ask next, and check whether steps you ran got done. heuristic: the reader alone, never a model call. model: always ask the fork.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest reply to ask the model about
minAnswerChars.description: Replies shorter than this are read without a model call.

nudgeAfter.title: Nudge about idle streams after this many turns
nudgeAfter.description: When a stream with open steps has had no new or finished steps for this many turns, a toast says so once, so you can pick it up or archive it. 0 turns this off.

band.title: Show the top steps above the prompt
band.description: A row above the prompt box with the top three open steps: press 1, 2 or 3 from an empty prompt box to use one, 0 to hide the row until the next turn.

ghostText.title: Offer the top step as ghost text
ghostText.description: Shows the top new step as dim text in the prompt box; Tab takes it as a draft.

statusLine.title: Count open steps in the status line
statusLine.description: Shows "✦ 3 next steps" in the status line while steps are open.

keepAcrossSessions.title: Keep open steps for the next session
keepAcrossSessions.description: Saves open steps per project folder and brings them back, folded, when a session starts there.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when new steps arrive
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane beside the transcript when steps are found, unless you closed it.

paneStyle.title: Where the tree is drawn inside herdr
paneStyle.description: auto: when Claude runs inside herdr, show the tree in a herdr pane of its own (plain characters, keys), and keep /upnext for the pane inside Claude. Outside herdr nothing changes. claude: always the pane inside Claude; /upnext herdr still opens the herdr pane on request.

herdrLabel.title: Show the open count on Claude's herdr pane
herdrLabel.description: Inside herdr, sets the title of Claude's pane to "3 next" while steps are open.

scanToolOutput.title: Read Bash output and task lists too
scanToolOutput.description: Adds hints like "run `npm audit fix`" from Bash output, and open todo/task items.
